title: Scale-up Engineer
description:
Business Unit: MAES
   

  

 Division: Packaging \& Board Assembly
   

  

**Challenge Yourself and Impact the Future!**
 MacDermid Alpha Electronics Solutions, a business segment of Element Solutions Inc (NYSE: ESI), is renowned worldwide for its commitment to revolutionizing the electronics industry. With a legacy spanning over a century, we have continually set new benchmarks for excellence, reliability and sustainability in electronic materials.
   

  

  

* Wafer Level Packaging \- Revolutionizing wafer fabrication processes for enhanced efficiency and performance
* Circuitry Solutions \- Tailored solutions to meet the dynamic demands of modern circuitry
* Electronics Assembly Solutions \- Innovating semiconductor, surface mount technology, and power electronics assembly for unparalleled reliability
* Advanced Materials and Joining \- Engineering polymer and metal joining solutions for optimally performing circuits
* Film \& Smart Surface Solutions \- Transforming electronics with cutting\-edge materials and technologies for enhanced functionality and reliability
* Micromax – Elevating electronics through high\-performing, specialized inks and pastes


 Across diverse sectors including automotive, consumer electronics, mobile devices, telecom, data storage, infrastructure, and AI, MacDermid Alpha Electronics Solutions has earned the trust of manufacturers worldwide. Our comprehensive range of high\-quality solutions and technical services enables the entire electronics supply chain, empowering businesses to thrive in today's competitive landscape.
   

  

 We embody the 'Elements of our Culture'\- our 5C's; Challenge, Commit, Collaborate, Choose, and Care. These core values are the foundation of our organization which our employees embrace in their interactions with customers, colleagues and other stakeholders, to drive financial performance and create a rewarding work environment.
   

  

**Who are we looking for?**
 The strategic focus of this position is to work in the Scale Up Laboratory to promote efficient product scale\-ups and support continuous improvement projects. This position will be working between Global Engineering and the R\&D and Supply Chain functions. The primary purpose of this position is to provide support to the Scale\-Up Lab by supervision and performing various quality control functions as it relates to the final product and the laboratory equipment.
   

  

**What will you be doing?**
* Ensure all required tests in support of the Scale\-Up lab are accurately completed in a timely manner and that the test results meet defined specifications.
* Supervise or perform testing for the batches that allows to understand characteristics and cause\-effects of the product and process.
* Evaluate data and draft reports, noting any relevant deviations from existing standards.
* Follow appropriate material test methods.
* Prepare and maintain test data for review.
* Schedule aging studies and report the data generated.
* Develop and maintain inspection reports.
* Support the ISO Management Systems and Safety Systems
* Maintain calibration of quality control equipment
* Maintain raw material storage area to include review and reporting of inventory levels, labeling, utilization of proper storage procedures, etc.
* Perform 5S auditing of lab area and report results on a regular basis.
* Assist with and oversee the storing and disposing of testing materials according to the internal procedures.
* Work closely with the Scale up team to work on batch making and troubleshooting as required.
* Ensure compliance with federal and state laws, as well as company standards and specifications.
* Identify areas for quality control improvement and implement new methods accordingly.
* Communicate any quality or compliance concerns with urgency
* Maintain good housekeeping and safety practices


**Who are You?**
* BS in Chemical Engineer/Chemistry \& \>7 years of relevant experience or MS \& \>3 years of relevant experience
* Effective level of exposure and training in Continuous Improvement Methodology, similar to the Green Belt as provided in Six Sigma
* Thorough engineering and application knowledge and can develop structure property relationships
* Solid understanding of key plant processes at primary manufacturing locations experience is preferable


**What competencies will you need?**
* Possesses well\-developed communication, organizational and interpersonal skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze and interpret information.
* Requires practical understanding and a working knowledge of a laboratory environment.
* Requires the ability to record and maintain data in computerized and non\-computerized formats.
* Carries out responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and applicable laws.
* Ability to work in a high\-paced and multi\-task environment.
* High ethical standards and ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Ability to read, write and follow written or verbal instructions.
* Ability to speak read and write English.
* Well\-organized and detail oriented.
* Self\-motivated.
* Demonstrated capacity to work with Microsoft Office Products, Lotus Notes, and other critical computer applications.


**We are Offering...**
 As part of our team here, as well as receiving a competitive base salary, you will also participate in a generous performance related bonus scheme. In addition, you will also be covered under our corporate medical insurance plan and annual leaves.
   

  

**Teamwork**
 At ESI, you will be part of a highly collaborative culture that promotes continuous improvement through cross\-functional partnerships to achieve our mission. We do this through a strong and unified culture and transparent management which has empowered us to create high performing global teams that achieve superior solutions for our customers
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category applicable under federal, state and local laws.

title: Test Support Maintenance Technician
description:
**About The Business**
 Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components.
   

  

 Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India’s first AI\-enabled state\-of\-the\-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high\-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence. Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata group.
   

  

 The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust.’
   

  

**Role Overview**
* To be responsible for establishment of product test process and maintenance test equipment in electronics manufacturing industry.
* Professional knowledge of Electronics / Mechanics.


**Key Responsibilities**
* To install, debug and accept new test equipment.
* To maintain test equipment and solve problems concerning with test equipment and test process to support production.
* To ensure that the product quality requirements are taken care of in the defined work area.
* To draft work instructions \& procedures, manage and update technical files.
* To develop the test process to reduce test cycle time.
* To draft training material and conduct training for operators.
* Cross project support \& assistance to meet the org objectives.
* Downtime analysis, Troubleshooting of tester and product, Issue Tracking, Contingency plan, backup solutions. Improvements, cost saving.
* Sound ICT Principles.
* ICT Programming knowledge.
* ICT Programming and fine tuning.
* Basics of Components\-Actives and Passives.
* Debugging and Analytical ability.
* Thorough Knowledge of Quality tools (Cpk, G R \& R, PFMEA).
* Tester Validation, ensure all products meet quality standards through rigorous testing. Zero defect, Lean, SOP/WI,8D,5W, GR \& R, CpCpK.6 Sigma.
* Test yield improvement / Direct test equipment troubleshooting / PM.
* Line set up / Edit new program / Order new fixture and check it / verify the new product line.
* Test method development / Test time reduction / capacity improvement.
* PM, implement process improvements to enhance efficiency. OEE, MTBF, MTTR. Effective spare Management.


**Essential Attributes**
* Communication
* Data Analytics
* Preventive Maintenance
* Teamwork
* Troubleshooting of tester issues
* Calibration of tester and Equipment
* Cross Functional Collaboration
* ECN/ECO
* Test software
* Interpersonal Relationship
* Product Quality Requirements
* Technology transfer


**Qualifications**
* Diploma/BE/BTECH/BCA/BSc


**Minimum Relevant Experience (in Years):** 
 2 to 15 Yrs
